dependency.training: scikit-learn decision-tree builder from frozen uv.lock

selection.rationale: The selected nonlinear candidate passed every predeclared evidence and runtime gate.
selection.selection_rule: Reject any leakage, determinism, parity, packaging, or runtime failure. Otherwise promote only a shallow nonlinear candidate whose paired OOF technical-score delta versus the two-feature linear champion is positive, whose 95% paired bootstrap interval is not materially negative, whose Hit@10 does not regress, whose fold/scenario behavior has no unexplained material regression, and whose added runtime and asset cost remain within checkpoint budgets. Prefer the smallest candidate within 0.005 technical score of the best valid candidate; otherwise park standalone.
